g.text: Where should the cloud of all size-B batch gradients be centered, and what happens at B=N?

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Conclusion: Every subset of size B is equally likely, sampled without replacement. Cloud mean = full gradient. Cov(g_B)=(N-B)

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: sum_i (g_i-g)(g_i-g)^T / [BN(N-1)]; B=N has zero sampling variance. No universal exact 1/B law is claimed.
